item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01220","case1_error":"Calculates fuel cost from miles directly, omitting division by 10 miles per gallon.","case2_error":"Lists seven unsupported answers, none equal to 980; no calculation reveals the error mechanism.","reason":"The first error is an identifiable unit-conversion omission; the second provides insufficient evidence to identify a specific mathematical mechanism.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01221","case1_error":"Adds increases for all three inches grown to the 66-inch baseline, although final height exceeds that baseline by only two inches.","case2_error":"Correctly derives 50/3 hits and reports both counts; the requested total is ambiguous, and the question implies impossible fractional event counts.","reason":"The first uses the wrong baseline. The second follows the stated ratio, while inconsistent counts and ambiguous wording prevent a clear error diagnosis.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01222","case1_error":"Relabels 15 training days per stage as weeks, omitting division by five; later-stage repetition descriptions also contradict their stated starting counts.","case2_error":"Subtracts rotten oranges but omits the 30 reserved for juice.","reason":"The first fails to convert training days into weeks; the second omits a distinct category of oranges excluded from sales.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01223","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written sum 30 + 35 + 46 as 101 instead of 111.","case2_error":"Treats all three initial packs as given away, despite the question specifying one pack.","reason":"The first is numerical evaluation of a correct expression; the second assigns the wrong quantity to packs given away.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01224","case1_error":"Uses 12 cups per set instead of 24, omitting the two-dozen multiplier.","case2_error":"Gives an unsupported final answer of 30 after correctly writing (32 + 13 + 15) − 20, which equals 40.","reason":"The first constructs an incorrect total; the second supplies a wrong final number after a correct formula without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
